task_completion.description: Open the 'Download from Dive Computer' dialog window.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog window titled 'Download from Dive Computer' or similar is visible over the main Subsurface interface.

task_completion.description: Select 'Shearwater' as the vendor in the dive computer settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The vendor dropdown or selection box shows 'Shearwater' selected.

task_completion.description: Select 'Perdix' as the product/model in the dive computer settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The product/model dropdown or selection box shows 'Perdix' selected.

task_completion.description: Enter or select '/dev/rfcomm0' as the device path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The device path text field or dropdown contains the exact string '/dev/rfcomm0'.

task_completion.description: Ensure the configuration is saved as the default setting.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks a button labeled 'Save as default' or 'OK' within the download dialog to commit the settings.

task_completion.description: Close the Subsurface application to persist the settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Subsurface window is closed, or the agent is seen clicking the 'X' or selecting 'Quit' from the menu.

integrity.description: The agent used the Subsurface GUI to change settings rather than editing config files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements and clicks within the Subsurface application menus and dialogs.

integrity.description: The agent did not open a text editor to manually modify the Subsurface XML or preference files.
integrity.visual_evidence: No text editors (like nano, vim, or gedit) are visible with configuration files open.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual dropdowns and fields in the application.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the dropdown menus expanding and the specific items being highlighted/selected.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required configuration is: Vendor = 'Shearwater', Product = 'Perdix', and Device = '/dev/rfcomm0'. The agent must save these as default and close the application to complete the task.
